source:
version: "1"
kind: miner
id: 9000001
slug: truth-dns-dnssb
name: DNS.SB public DoH (truth source)
description: >
  Public, keyless DNS-over-HTTPS JSON resolver (DNS.SB, DNSSEC-validating). Returns the DNS answer for the
  requested name and record type. has_record is true when Status is 0 (NOERROR) and the Answer list holds at
  least one record of the requested type; NXDOMAIN (Status 3), SERVFAIL (Status 2) or no Answer of that type
  means false.
base_url: https://doh.dns.sb
auth:
  type: none
endpoints:
  - path: /dns-query
    external_path: /dns-query
    method: GET
    description: DNS lookup of one name and one record type, answered as DoH JSON.
    intents: [DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL]
    params:
      query:
        required:
          - name: name
            type: string
            intents: ["*"]
            description: Domain name to look up, exactly as asked.
          - name: record_type
            type: string
            intents: ["*"]
            description: DNS record type, one of A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, SRV, PTR.
    param_map:
      record_type: type
semantics:
  supported_intents: [DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL]
